content.description:
This proposal suggests block #69420 for the upgrade, which is estimated to be at Sunday Oct. 23 7:00 PM UTC, +/- 5 hours using avg block time of 6.247111533 secs https://go.dev/play/p/mN9V5C6wvSp When the network reaches the halt height, the state machine of the blockchain will be halted. Cosmovisor, if configured properly, will then switch the binary used to v0.1.1, and then the chain will continue to make progress.
In the event of an issue at upgrade time, we will coordinate via the verified-validators channel in discord.
